summary: Add the ПЭК logistics SDK adapter and admit a separate Delivery surface for encrypted credentials and authenticated health checks; shipment writes remain qualification-gated.

impacts.evidence: ПЭК credentials are bound to one tenant-scoped connector account; caller-supplied tenant overrides are not accepted.
The Basic username/access key stays behind SecretProvider and normalized SDK evidence excludes raw provider payloads and recipient PII.
No new public HTTP or OpenAPI operation is introduced; the existing connector-account control plane is reused for setup and health checks.
No event or canonical envelope is added.
The adapter uses the frozen Connector SDK v1 and additive logistics capability interfaces.
No provider-specific table or migration is introduced; connector accounts and health history remain provider-neutral.
The host performs TLS-verified, public-destination-only requests and uses Basic material only inside the callback-scoped secret path.
Shipment creation is not admitted to application callers; future write admission must pass capability and approval policy.
Credential health checks use the existing connector.account.connection_checked audit event and retain only safe health metadata.
The SDK request carries canonical idempotency fields; no scheduler or write retry is enabled until current API fixtures are qualified.
The current surface performs only a fixed outbound health probe; no arbitrary callback or webhook ingress is added.
Manifest timeout/retry metadata and normalized provider-unavailable health states bound the remote probe.
The separate-surface entry can be disabled by runtime support metadata without destructive rollback.
Deterministic SDK and conformance candidate tests cover rates, shipment, tracking, pickup, tenant isolation and idempotency without production credentials.
